ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast with a dominant distribution of low-intensity (dark) pixels; high-intensity (white/grey) pixels are localized to mottling and scar tissue, estimated at a 1:7 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark pigmentation with diffuse mid-intensity grey mottling concentrated in the central-medial region and distal lobes; localized high-contrast circular pixel rings (scars) on the right ventral lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation at the central axis dividing the lobes with a defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations and jagged notches extracted along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to acute distal points; trailing edges exhibit a generally concave trajectory interrupted by significant serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 5-7 circular, ring-like high-contrast pixel clusters on the mid-to-inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of white, high-intensity barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; extensive irregular trailing edge topography indicating traumatic tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Combination of distinctive circular scarring and highly irregular 'chewed' trailing edge profile.
